headline: Senegal: 55 billion FCFA raised at higher rates than Côte d'Ivoire
summary: Senegal's Treasury raised 55 billion CFA francs at its November 20, 2026 auction on the regional securities market. The financing came at materially less favourable terms than several other West African Monetary Union states obtained.
why: Senegal's sovereign borrowing costs on the regional market signal investor pricing of its debt and affect the government's financing budget.
original_headline: Sénégal : 55 milliards de FCFA levés à des taux plus chers que la Côte d’Ivoire
